rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for general improvement or betterment.

example.english: There has been improvement in this arrangement.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 goi2 sin6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on progress or becoming better, especially for a person, skill, or performance.

example.english: Your Cantonese has shown improvement lately.
example.traditional: 你最近廣東話有進步喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jau5 zeon3 bou6 wo3

rows.note: Use this for a concrete improvement made to a product, design, system, or edition.

example.english: This version is much more stable after the improvement.
example.traditional: 呢個版本經過改進，穩定咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baan2 bun2 ging1 gwo3 goi2 zeon3 wan2 ding6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when a condition or situation has taken a turn for the better, especially health or other circumstances.

example.english: Mom's condition has shown improvement after taking medicine.
example.traditional: 媽媽食藥之後病情有好轉。
example.jyutping: maa1 maa1 sik6 joek6 zi1 hau6 beng6 cing4 jau5 hou2 zyun2
